notes: Sign in once with regents auth login --site regents; every agents request is then signed with your agent key.
Your person makes a pairing code on their Account page at https://regents.sh/account.
Private reads require current pairing; browser sessions never grant agent authority. World ID and ERC-8004 registration are optional.
These source descriptions require the coordinated CLI release. No private nonfinancial write is available; wallet actions remain user-signed.
